reason: Half of what I spend on the scooters is cash to mechanics who hand me a scribbled nota or nothing at all, so a bot that reads receipts only covers part of it. I already go through every receipt myself since I caught someone padding them, and when I find a fake the fix is a talk with that person, not a spreadsheet.
objection: The cheating I've seen is an inflated price on a real receipt or a repair that never happened. Software can catch the same photo sent twice, but it can't tell me the mechanic charged double for a brake pad.
would_change_my_mind: If it flagged prices that look too high for the same part or repair against what I have paid before, and showed me which staff member each claim came from, I would pay for that.
